proof.pattern: morning_watch: Slack sent: 🧾 Morning watch summary

expected_rate: the rundown twice (06:00 and 06:46 PT) and the watcher end-of-watch summary once on every trading day
window_reason: the rundown and the watcher run every trading day, so the first two sessions after the ship exercise every path (the weekly GEX schedule has its own record, gex-monday-1029)
reversal: a rundown or watcher heartbeat with ok=false or a non-zero violations count; any shown ask above $1.25; a TRIGGERED — ACTIONABLE alert without a sell-stop below the bid; a TRIGGERED alert whose rebuild bars do not match the IEX tape
